mapper.select: SELECT TRUNC(START_DATE) AS START_DATE , TRUNC(END_DATED) AS END_DATE FROM COURSE WHERE ID = #{courseId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_TIME_TABLE ( ID , COURSE_ID , DATETIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT , TIME ) VALUES ( 'CI-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_COURSE_TIME_TABLE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{courseId}, #{date}, #{agenda}, #{subject}, #{time} )
mapper.select: SELECT DATETIME , TIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY DATETIME ASC, TIME ASC
SELECT DATETIME , TIME , AGENDA , SUBJECT FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND DATETIME >= #{date} AND DATETIME < #{date} + 1 ORDER BY TIME ASC
